 Department of Health

 Hospitals & Primary Care - Hospitals NW

 Primary Health North West





 Applications must be submitted by Sunday 02 August, 2026 11:55 PM 




Position details




 

 

 
Applications close:

 
Sunday 2 August, 2026 11:55 PM AEST

Nurses and Midwives (Tasmanian State Service) Award, Registered Nurse, Grade 6

Fixed-term, part-time

 

 

 
Region:

 
North West

 

 

Located in:

Central Coast CHC, Ulverstone


 

 
Job description:

 
Within a Primary Health Care Framework, Agency policies, legal requirements and professional competencies the Clinical Nurse Consultant - Neurological Support Service will:
- provide advanced clinical leadership, specialist assessment and clinical care for individuals with Parkinson's disease and related neurological conditions. 
- work with a high level of autonomy within an inter-professional team, ensuring the delivery of evidence-based, person-centred care across community, primary health, residential care and acute settings. 
- the role leads education, quality improvement and service development initiatives that support optimal clinical outcomes and enhance the capability of the broader health workforce.

 

 






 

The Team

The North West Neurological Support Service provides advanced clinical leadership and clinical care for individuals living in the community with Parkinson's disease and related neurological conditions. This position works with a high level of autonomy within a multidisciplinary team to deliver evidence based, person centred care within the community, primary health and residential aged care setting in the north west of Tasmania.

The Role

We are looking for motivated individuals passionate about supporting clients with Parkinsons and related neurological conditions. As well as providing support to those living with Parkinson's Disease, this position leads and provides education to professionals, community members and organisations as well as coordinating multidisciplinary care to ensure continuity, integration and best outcomes for clients.

You will need:

The ability to work autonomously, operating at a high level of professional independence and function consistently at a high level

Excellent communication skills and ability to build effective professional relationships with clients, carers, community health providers and members of the wider multidisciplinary team.

Provide specialist education and support to clients, carers, community and the professionals

Note: - Please refer to the Statement of Duties for all the selection criteria of this position to address in your application.

Details of appointment

Fixed term, part time, day worker position, working up to 32 hours per fortnight, 27 September 2026 until 25 September 2027. *notwithstanding hours to be negotiated with the successful applicant.

Applicants should note that, for a period of twelve months from the date of publication, this selection process may be used to fill subsequent or similar full time, part time, and casual vacancies.

Salary

$118,297 to $125,543 per annum (Pro rata). Our Employer 12% superannuation contribution is on top of this amount.

Salary range is in accordance with Nurses and Midwives (Tasmania State Service) Agreement 2023.

In addition, the following allowances calculated on the salaried incremental point may be available:

Post Graduate Allowance of up to 10% based on qualification type

Salary Packaging 

You'll have access to salary package a range of benefits including living expenses up to $9,010 + $2,650 in meal entertainment each FBT year + other benefits if eligible.

Benefits available to eligible candidates

Travel and relocation assistance support available up to $15,000 for eligible appointees from overseas, and up to $10,000 for appointees from interstate.

Professional development and accelerated pathways.

A range of leave entitlements, including study leave and Professional Development Support.

Fitness Passport - You, and your family can access 40+ fitness facilities across Tasmania for just $14.50 per week per person, or $28.05 for a family.

Eligibility

Successful applicants will be required to meet the essential criteria

Registered with the Nursing and Midwifery Board of Australia as a Registered Nurse.

Current Driver's Licence.

Applicants should note the following criteria are desirable:

Holds a relevant nursing tertiary qualification or is working towards a relevant post graduate tertiary qualification
